verdict.rationale: Skills are plain directories made of `SKILL.md` plus optional scripts and references (docs-13, docs-28). They are installed from public GitHub sources, and the curated marketplace manifest is a public catalog that lists source paths (docs-61, probe-rt-1, gh-11). A hands-on install landed readable files at `./.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, where Codex scans for them (probe-rt-2, docs-17), so a lead can inspect the source repo beforehand and read every file afterward. However, this relies on manually browsing GitHub and the filesystem rather than a built-in review step. Missing for 10: a documented pre-install content listing or diff in `$skill-installer` or the `/plugins` browser, a documented way to inspect the files of plugins installed through the ChatGPT Plugins tab, and independent corroboration of a safety-review workflow.
